title: SDD proposal (LLM reply), version 2
description: Authoritative shape of a proposal object (SDD R-S13). Kind-specific field sets are checked by C-S4 against the prompt's slots (R-S20, E-CHK-FIELDS). Human-only field names are admitted here so that R-S10 reports them as E-CHK-HUMAN-FIELD rather than as a shape error. Version 2 (SDD v0.5): iceClass may be null (R-S5); valueProperty is no longer a field of any artifact and fails this schema (additionalProperties, R-S10).
